verdict.rationale: Poly documents an official sync service: files appear as a real folder in Finder/Explorer, download on demand and sync back automatically, offline changes queue and sync when you reconnect, and it is available on web and desktop. Nothing in the evidence mentions end-to-end encryption or zero-knowledge storage, which is the defining element of this story. missing for 10: any evidence of end-to-end encryption the vendor can't read, explicit multi-device (including mobile) sync coverage, independent corroboration of sync reliability.
